text:
The time spent sailing outward is from 1 PM to 4 PM, which is 3 hours.
Distance traveled = $\text{Speed} \times \text{Time} = 10 \text{ mph} \times 3 \text{ hours} = 30 \text{ miles}$.

For the return trip:
Time = $\frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Speed}} = \frac{30 \text{ miles}}{6 \text{ mph}} = 5 \text{ hours}$.

ANSWER: 5
